edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier runs _onlyOwner before nominateNewOwner body.
onlyOwner modifier runs _onlyOwner before initiateRelay body.
onlyOwner modifier runs _onlyOwner before initiateRelayBatch body.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside _onlyOwner.
Stored owner state variable is read during the _onlyOwner check.
msg.sender must match nominatedOwner in acceptOwnership.
nominatedOwner is read and compared in acceptOwnership.
acceptOwnership assigns nominatedOwner into owner.
nominateNewOwner parameter writes nominatedOwner.

normalization_plan.reason: _owner parameter is only used to write nominatedOwner in nominateNewOwner.
target parameter is used solely inside initiateRelay's encode and external call.
payload parameter is used solely inside initiateRelay's message construction.
crossDomainGasLimit parameter only influences initiateRelay's gas limit.
targets parameter is used only inside initiateRelayBatch.
payloads parameter is used only inside initiateRelayBatch.
crossDomainGasLimit parameter only influences initiateRelayBatch's gas limit.
name parameter is consumed directly by requireAndGetAddress lookup.
crossDomainGasLimit parameter is the sole input of _getCrossDomainGasLimit.
_owner constructor parameter initializes the owner state variable.
_resolver constructor parameter initializes the resolver state variable.
messageData local is produced and consumed entirely within initiateRelay.
messageDataBatch local is produced and consumed entirely within initiateRelayBatch.
